visual.general_description: Two side-by-side endoscopic photographs, panels A and B, of reddish bowel mucosa with a curved fold and a small pale pink nodule in each, with endoscope overlay text in the black upper-right corner of each frame.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: Endoscopic view of pink to red mucosa filling the frame. A smooth mucosal fold curves from the upper left around a small dark opening near the top centre. A small pale pink rounded nodule sits on the mucosa just left of the opening. The lower left shows finely granular mucosa with fine red vessel-like markings, and a few white bubbles or specks lie on the surface. A black border at the upper right carries partly legible endoscope overlay text: a row of small empty boxes after a capital letter, a year-like number, a clock-time-like string ending in AM and a short letter code. No panel-specific labels other than the letter A are visible. Panel B: Endoscopic view of uniformly red mucosa with a curved fold running from the upper right toward the lower centre, forming a narrowed dark channel at the centre right. A small pale pink rounded nodule lies on the mucosa just right of the centre. Scattered white bubbles or specks are present on the surface. A black border at the upper right carries partly legible endoscope overlay text similar to panel A: a capital letter followed by empty boxes, a year-like number and a clock-time-like string. No panel labels other than the letter B are visible.

visual.general_description: Two stained tissue-section micrographs, panel A at low power and panel B at high power, with panel B showing pink and purple tissue with gland-like lumens within cellular stroma.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: Low-power pink and purple stained tissue section on a pale background. A large solid pink tissue fragment fills most of the frame and shows several fine dark crack lines. Within it are three irregular pale spaces: a small one near the upper centre, a rounded one at the upper right with a purple centre, and a larger one at the lower centre containing folded purple-lined material. A pale vacuolated band with a few round pink structures runs along the lower left and bottom edges, and a thin purple-blue fringed edge lies at the lower right. The upper left shows a pale lacy margin with a small round pink ring. The letter A is printed in the upper left. Panel B: High-power pink and purple stained section showing several branching pale gland-like lumens, the largest near the lower centre containing pale fluffy contents. Each lumen is lined by a single layer of purple-blue nuclei and surrounded by pink cellular stroma with elongated and oval nuclei. Small red blood cell-like specks lie among the stroma at the upper left. The letter B is printed in the upper left. No scale bar is visible.
